hyps.why: Without the direct 0->3 edge, all signal flows through the multi-hop paths, so adding a 3x3 conv on edge 0 helps more.
A skip on edge 3 already supplies a residual path, so a conv on edge 5 adds less.
With a direct skip to the output already present, an extra conv on edge 4 has diminishing returns.
Removing edge 0 is much less damaging when a direct skip path still connects input to output.
Dropping edge 1 hurts less when the skip on edge 3 keeps the output connected.
Adding a skip where there was no edge gives a larger gain than replacing an existing conv with a skip.
Putting a conv on an empty edge adds capacity, whereas replacing a skip with a conv loses the residual path.
With edge 1 removed, edge 2 is the only way into node 2, so conv quality there matters more.
If edge 3 is already absent, removing edge 5 cuts a major route to the output and is much more damaging.
Without the direct edge, removing edge 4 further restricts the paths to the output and hurts accuracy more.
